title: China Q&A | From Dujiangyan to Haizhu: how an ancient philosophy is reshaping global conservation
description: In this episode of China Q&A, we bring together Stewart Maginnis, deputy director general of the International Union for Conservation of Nature (IUCN), and Luo Ming, a research fellow at China's Ministry of Natural Resources, to explore how China's ancient idea of "harmony between humanity and nature" is being translated into real-world solutions for a planet in crisis.

title: European drought reveals 100-year-old steam boat and ancient Roman bridge
